prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='ONLY_DWT_rf', seasonality_champion='ONLY_DWT_rf', recommended_method='median_or_trimmed_mean'. Narrative: ONLY_DWT_rf dominates across all dimensions: perfect trend correlation (1.0), highest seasonality correlation (0.7187), and lowest RMSE (86.65). However, rankings are highly unstable (Kendall τ=0.1345) with extreme model disagreement (RMSE spread ratio=54.96), suggesting robust combiners like median/trimmed_mean over stacking to avoid overfitting noise. Concept drift detected and autocorrelated residuals in most models further support robust aggregation.
